description: This is a Java interface defining a service for managing product images, including adding, retrieving, removing, and updating images associated with products in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImageService
classes.description: Service interface providing methods for managing product images, including adding, fetching, saving, updating, and removing images for products.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the persistence layer and the CMS.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image content as OutputContentFile, optionally specifying size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Returns a list of all images associated with a specific product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing product image.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image file based on store code, product code, filename, and size, used by image servlet.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple images to a product.
